# Builder Base
> The distribution layer for builders in India. Connecting ambitious developers with products, technology ecosystems, and opportunities worth building on.

Builder Base is an engineering-first community and distribution platform for developers across India. We organize high-craft developer events, hackathons, AI workshops, build days, and residencies.

## Core Information
- Canonical Website: https://builderbase.xyz
- Official Calendar: https://luma.com/Builderbase
- Twitter / X: https://x.com/theBuilder_base
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/builder-base
- Community Portal: https://link3.to/builderbase
- Primary Contact: https://builderbase.xyz/contact

## Footprint Across India
- Delhi NCR: Build Nights, Protocol Sprints, Hackathons
- Bhopal: Claude Code Build Days, Agent Labs, Engineering Meetups
- Mumbai: Devcon & Ecosystem Gatherings, Developer Nights
- Indore: Community Nights, AI Developer Gatherings
- Manali: Hack in the Hills (Developer Residency)
- Kolkata: Protocol Nights, Technical Sessions

## Partnership & Distribution
Builder Base helps global technology platforms, foundation AI labs, and developer tooling protocols achieve authentic distribution in India through hands-on technical workshops, hackathons, and sustained developer activation.
Inquire: https://builderbase.xyz/partners
